label: First unde: what a thing has in act, given that it has being, is actual in it through esse
paraphrase: OPEN, analyst formulation of the first 'unde' of ST I q.4 a.1 ad 3 ('Nihil enim habet actualitatem, nisi inquantum est: unde ipsum esse est actualitas omnium rerum, et etiam ipsarum formarum'), attribution deferred. For every x and respect r: if x has r in act and x has being, then r is actual in x through esse, in the act reading (ACTUALIZED_THROUGH_2, a primitive). With R-dep (7067553d) it is equivalent to 'esse is the actuality of every form had in act'. On the dependence reading (ACTUALIZED_THROUGH_1) it holds in every frame. It does not say that esse is received or limited.
